name: dark-factory
description: Always-on fences for agent-driven development: a guard hook (no force push, no push to main, no hook bypass, merges only with a named human acceptance, the fences and the installed plugin protected), a Claude subscription quota guard, git-hook self-repair, /dark-factory:init for a solo starter kit, /dark-factory:add for the full harness and its modules, /dark-factory:provision-server and /dark-factory:factory-status for a server of projects, /dark-factory:level for the project's level on the ladder and /dark-factory:feature for the feature pipeline workflows.
